experiment_data.hypothesis: Adaptive Sample Budget: extension of E_θ threshold optimization to sample count N. Instance features (degeneracy, LP variance, agreement rate) predict optimal N per instance. Under fixed total budget=8 (average), adaptive allocation outperforms uniform N=8 by allocating more samples to high-uncertainty instances and fewer to degenerate/easy ones.
